bifrost: springboard/src/net/wifi.rs (Wifi, Status, Cmd), springboard/src/net/wpa.rs (ScanResult), springboard/src/net/wifi_config.rs (NetworkConfig, Security), springboard/src/net/wifi_event.rs, netd service (springboard/docs/services.md:49), springboard/src/shell/wifi_page.rs, springboard/src/shell/desktop_network.rs
summary: The Wi-Fi system layer covers most of what CoreWLAN reads and changes (interface discovery, scan, join, saved profiles, RSSI, security types) and netd publishes it as Status events. No app-facing SDK API exists: springboard/sdk/src/ has no network module, so apps cannot query interfaces, networks or events the way CWWiFiClient allows. Interface configuration for access-point and IBSS modes, channel and PHY detail, and Wi-Fi keychain functions are not covered.

gaps: No app-facing SDK API: springboard/sdk/src/ has no network module, so apps cannot list interfaces, scan, join or read status.
Typed event delegate: netd sends one Status snapshot, not per-event callbacks (ssid, bssid, link, power, scan cache, mode, country code, link quality).
Channel, band, width and PHY mode are not decoded (ScanResult keeps freq only).
Access-point and IBSS configuration and channel setting are absent.
Wi-Fi keychain domain and EAP identity list do not exist; passwords live in the config file.
WEP and WPA-only personal security types are not supported (Security enum).
Link quality beyond RSSI (noise, transmit rate) is not reported.
